title: interaction
category: sub-skill of image-to-react · controls, scroll points & animation triggers
short_summary: wires 100% live controls, sliders, pagination, intersectionobserver scroll points, and animation triggers while keeping t=0 locked.
when_to_use: use in stage 3 of jason-dev-agent when wiring buttons, sliders, pagination, scroll-point waypoints, and animation triggers.
summary: Audits, upgrades, and evaluates Golden Template React builds so every page element has live stateful interaction while keeping the initial t=0 render visually locked. Explores and grades rich pattern upgrades grounded in original inspiration—sliders, carousels, pagination, live filters, swatches, scroll navigation, and story progression—in a multi-turn dev self-eval loop, then hands the same stage back to jason-design-agent via design-critique until approved. Use whenever adding, checking, or critiquing interactive elements, sliders, pagination, scrolling, or storytelling in an image-to-React build. Don't use for static pixel extraction alone (use replicate-mock) or motion timing tuning alone (use feel).
